description: Local-first feedback import, deduplication, AI candidate analysis, human review, and audit-preserving export.

stages.name: Import authorized feedback
stages.description: Validate user-provided, public, or authorized connector records before local persistence.

required_inputs.description: Authorized CSV, JSON, sample, or configured connector records

artifacts.description: Validated feedback rows with stable content hashes

stages.name: Deduplicate feedback
stages.description: Use stable content hashes to avoid repeated rows without deleting existing data.

artifacts.description: New feedback rows and duplicate counters

stages.name: Produce analysis candidates
stages.description: Run deterministic mock analysis or an explicitly configured provider while preserving original input.

artifacts.description: Model candidates with type, sentiment, severity, evidence, and confidence

stages.name: Review model candidates
stages.description: Record human corrections separately from the immutable candidate output.

artifacts.description: Human review records and approval state

stages.name: Export reviewed feedback
stages.description: Create stable CSV or JSON output while retaining both AI and human audit fields.

artifacts.description: Reviewed UTF-8-SIG CSV or JSON export

approval_gates.name: Approve authoritative export
approval_gates.description: Confirm human review before an export is used as an authoritative operational result.

safety.network_policy: Mock analysis is offline. DeepSeek and Apify network access require explicit environment configuration.

side_effects.description: Writes authorized feedback rows to the configured local SQLite database.
May call an explicitly configured model provider when mock mode is disabled.
Appends a human review record without overwriting the original model result.
Writes a CSV or JSON artifact selected by the operator.

idempotency.description: Import deduplication is content-addressed; schema migrations are additive and safe to repeat.
